name: @tachui/ssr
description: Server-side rendering and static prerender utilities for tachUI

scripts.build: rm -rf dist tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && vite build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:dev: rm -rf dist tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && vite build --mode development && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:prod: rm -rf dist tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && vite build --mode production && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json

author: tachUI Team
